title: Bonds and Fixed Income: Lending at Interest
author: StockIQ

cover.alt: A ribbon-tied paper parcel beside a row of equal coins marching along a timeline to a calendar — money lent out that returns steadily, with interest.

blurb: The other half of most portfolios. Learn how a loan becomes a tradable asset, why its price moves opposite to its yield, and how much a rate move can really cost you.
